Who we are

Chefs

Giovanni Rossi

Head Chef

Hailing from the heart of Italy, Chef Giovanni Rossi brings a taste of the Mediterranean to every dish he creates. With a focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients and time-honored recipes passed down through generations, his rustic yet refined Italian cuisine transports diners to the sun-drenched shores of the Amalfi Coast with every bite

Marcus Nguyen

Executive Chef

A master of Asian fusion cuisine, Chef Marcus Nguyen combines traditional Vietnamese flavors with modern culinary trends to create dishes that are both nostalgic and innovative. His meticulous attention to detail and artistic plating elevate each dish to a culinary masterpiece, earning him acclaim among food enthusiasts worldwide.

Isabella Santos

Executive Chef

With a culinary journey spanning continents, Chef Isabella Santos infuses her dishes with a harmonious blend of Latin American flavors and European techniques. Known for her creative fusion cuisine, she delights diners with vibrant presentations and bold, innovative flavors that pay homage to her rich cultural heritage.
